verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built to be driven through the user's own AI agent in natural language. It provides a hosted MCP server to add in an agent host, installs skill files for Claude Code and Codex, and its docs describe simply asking the agent to call MCP tools like `status` and letting the agent handle processes such as incorporating, hiring and payroll. Ultrametric runs no model itself, so natural-language interpretation depends entirely on the user's agent plan, and recorded probes only show the `init` dry run and auth walls rather than an actual conversational session. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end natural-language-driven process run, and first-party documentation of example natural-language prompts or workflows.
